method.features: colour (Lab, HSV), per-image standardised Lab, local mean and std at 1.5 m and 4 m, gradient, Laplacian texture, vegetation and blue indices
method.validation: leave-one-date-out: each date is predicted by a model trained only on the other 16 dates
method.baseline: nearest class centroid on per-image standardised L, a, b (colour only)
method.land_edge: compared as a line: distance from the traced edge to the model land / estuary boundary
